text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Racing's finest are gathered here for the
3,000-meter turf G2 Hanshin
Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's excited for the face-off
between Racers of the Year Narita
Brian
and Mayano Top Gun!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The extraordinary crowd at the Hanshin
Racecourse is waiting with
bated breath to
see the amazing finish to come!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Something about this feels different from
Brian's other races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Until now we've only been bystanders
overwhelmed by Brian's
achievements.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But now... things are different, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Race with all your spirit,
Brian. And we'll
cheer for you with all of ours.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I will... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We'd better get to the stands then!
I saved
us one heck of a spot!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right, Brian, you should head for the
paddock. Come on, I'll walk
you over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Okay... I'm off then.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We wish you all the best.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ah! Here she is!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You look like you're ready. Your desire to
run is written all over your
face.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to test the results of
training
with you two.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't need to say how skilled Mayano
Top Gun is, but your real
opponent today
will be yourself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A one-on-one match against
yourself—you'd better win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I got this.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've amazed me on countless occasions.
Fantastic times, surprising
finishes,
victories in the biggest races...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You've amazed me on countless occasions.
Fantastic times, surprising
finishes,
victories in the biggest races...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And I know you're going to continue to
amaze me. Nothing's ever
dampened your
drive to win since I met you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And I know you're going to continue to
amaze me. Nothing's ever
dampened your
drive to win since I met you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh... I won't disappoint!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So many people are here! They must be
excited to see this
Racer-of-the-Year
showdown!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And I'm right there with them!
I can't wait
to race you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If I'm not mistaken,
you can't pull off the
running style you used
before your injury.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But your passion for racing is still
there!
Your feelings haven't
changed at all!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: So I've got to race at full throttle too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It wouldn't be right to say my
feelings haven't changed at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I used to run like winning was inevitable.
But when winning stopped
being a given,
it started to feel impossible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yet the farther away victory seemed, the
hungrier I got. Every time it slipped
through my fingers, it's like my heart was
set ablaze over and
over.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I am now burning to win!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Great! But I won't lose, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good, I'm counting on it!
